input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text, /moves/bishop_c8.text, or /moves/rook_a8.text, the paths of agents that have gone off plan again and again, must be signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen agents' keys in /team/pieces/, including the moving piece itself.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_a8.id)] false))
